q.en: Can we showcase photos from across the decades on the invitation and at the venue?

a.en: Yes. Our digital anniversary invitations feature an interactive Story & Gallery view, and on the night we coordinate projector slideshows and a live guest photo wall.

q.en: Do you cater for multi-generational family gatherings?

a.en: Yes. We select step-free accessible Perth venues, arrange comfortable seating for elders and children's menus for younger guests, and manage all dietary needs.
